comment: Compiles the fixture the way an external consumer would: it imports the
resolved through node_modules — NOT via a paths mapping. `check.mjs` copies
this fixture into an OS temp dir (outside the package, so package
self-reference can't bypass the tarball), extracts the `npm pack` tarball
into <temp>/node_modules/zod-nostr, and compiles there — so resolution goes
through the real package.json#exports and the tarball's `files`, catching a
dropped './mini' export, a missing declaration, or a wrong entry point, on
top of the emitted-.d.ts type contract. Run it with `npm run test:consumer`.
